resources.string: Create shortcuts on your home screen to specific images or videos in the gallery.
Share from gallery\nWhile viewing an image or video in the gallery, tap share and select Image Shortcut or Video Shortcut.
Add widget from home screen\nFrom the widgets section of the home screen, scroll to Media Shortcut and select Image Shortcut or Video Shortcut.
Development of this app has cost several evenings and weekends.\nYet it is completely free and has no advertisements.
